title: decomposition.json
description: Ticket breakdown produced by /decompose. Validated by you, then consumed one subtask at a time by /plan.

ticket.description: Raw tracker ID, e.g. REGIS-142 or DEV-317

recipe.description: Matched recipe name, or "no-match" when handed back

needs_human_review.description: true when a subtask is destructive, the ticket didn't match a recipe, or scope is unclear. Blocks auto-advance in /ship.

subtasks.description: Ordered subtasks. Each becomes its own /plan run with its own slug, spec, and plan.json.

id.description: Two-digit ordinal, e.g. "01". depends_on references these.

seam.description: The contract fixed up front — endpoint signature + DTO, field spec, migration name, component props. This is what lets the subtask be planned in isolation.

scope_hint.description: Narrowest glob(s) this subtask should touch. /plan tightens this into task scopes; it is a hint, not the fence.

depends_on.description: Subtask ids that must complete first.

parallel_safe.description: true if it shares no seam with a sibling. Marks what could run together; default execution is still sequential.

migration.description: Migration risk class per the migration rule, or null.
